calibration.method: isotonic (out_of_bounds=clip), fitted on validation only, applied to the selected distribution
calibration.deploymentRule: deploy only if cross-fitted within-validation logLoss gain (early half fit, late half evaluation) exceeds 0.0005; deployed calibrator refit on full validation

recency.rule: exponential recency weighting (mean-1 sample weights halving every half-life days, age measured from the validation start) is tuned jointly with alpha/feature sets and ships only when the best weighted fit beats the best unweighted fit by more than the deadband

notes: Predictors are pre-match rolling/history features only.
League rolling-average baseline uses prior matches only.
Early-2000s rows without foul/shot coverage drop out via the availability flags.
NB2 deployment is selected on validation mean line logLoss with a 0.0005 deadband in favour of Poisson.
Calibration deployment is selected on cross-fitted within-validation logLoss gain (early half fit, late half evaluated) with the same deadband; test raw-vs-calibrated is reported either way.
